lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day one. Your phone shows you tomorrow.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: 9:14 AM. A man drops his coffee.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day four. Las Vegas. It knows the winning number.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day twelve. Miami. It shows a storm, and a bridge that falls at noon.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: You block the road. Everyone yells at you.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: At noon, the bridge goes down. Nobody is on it.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Day twenty-one. A message, from your own number.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: And this isn't all fiction. Google DeepMind's AI already forecasts the weather ten days ahead.

lines.speaker: nar
lines.text: Would you look at tomorrow? Follow for more what-ifs.
